subject: website
name: Astro Hsu (許明恩)
summary: The personal card of Astro Hsu, founder of Blocktrend. It is one HTML file with a readable inline script, served as written, so it is its own public source. It runs no third-party code, which is Level 3. It is not Level 4: when it opens it loads Google Fonts, images from urusai.cc, Wikimedia and books.com.tw, and a QR code from api.qrserver.com.

connections.name: Google Fonts
connections.note: Fetched when the page opens; tells Google the visit.
